formula.name: annual percentage rate (apr)
formula.formula: APR = ((Fees + Interest) / Principal) × (365 / Days in Loan Term)
formula.explanation: Fees: Fees associated with the loan, Interest: Interest amount, Principal: Loan amount, Days in Loan Term: Duration of the loan in days
